transport.scope: Complete ECAL with local services, B=0, no tracker/beam pipe/solenoid/HCAL/FCAL

observables.S: Sum of all raw Geant4 active ECAL deposits (barrel plus endcap collections), GeV
observables.f: Independent calibration population mean(S / 50 GeV), effective visible response fraction including losses
observables.T: S / (50 GeV * f), held-out response; no evaluation recentering
widths: sample SD/mean invariant under constant correction

statistics.bootstrap: Independent calibration/evaluation resampling and independent detectors; refit one common f per bootstrap replica
statistics.intervals: Pointwise 95% percentile, conditional on the frozen transports; no detector/physics-list systematics

direction_selection.basis: Geometry-only max-min tangential active-window clearance, frozen before new showers
direction_selection.scope: Favourable interior direction, not a global response optimum or completely gap-free; same direction for LAr/SiW
